title: Onboardify
tagline: Mainnet Ready: a safer pathway from crypto simulation to real mainnet use
description: Mainnet Ready is a staged entry pathway for people entering Web3 safely. Users begin in Mirror Mode, a mainnet-like environment where they can practice wallets, payments, swaps, lending, borrowing, bridges, gas, approvals, scams, and liquidations using simulated assets. They then move into Guarded Mainnet, where real transactions can use delay windows, cancelable intents, risk checks, and approval flows before final execution. Finally, users earn a Mainnet Passport proving they understand key risks before operating independently on mainnet.
how_its_made: We are building a web app with three connected layers: Mirror Mode, Guarded Mainnet, and Mainnet Passport. Mirror Mode simulates core Web3 actions such as swaps, lending, borrowing, bridges, approvals, scams, and gas behavior. Guarded Mainnet introduces delayed/cancelable transaction intents before final execution, creating an “undo window” without reversing finalized blockchain transactions. The Passport layer records user readiness across different Web3 risk areas, such as wallet safety, DeFi, bridging, approvals, and scam resistance.
auto_summary: A Next.js app that teaches safer Web3 usage through simulation, delayed transaction execution, and wallet-based onboarding.
